Pillow Massagers Our popular shiatsu pillow massagers includes powerful 3D deep tissue massage nodes. that help relax overused and tight muscles. The massage nodes change rotation to mimic a natural, shiatsu hand massage. Eases tension and fatigue caused by stress, post-workout muscle soreness and any body pain triggered by repetitive physical activity.All of our pillow back massagers feature a heat function that helps increase blood circulation for a more relaxing and soothing massage. Mainly used for the upper and lower back area, our versatile shiatsu back massagers can also be used on your arms, neck, legs, feet and hands too. Neck Massagers Our shiatsu neck massagers feature arm straps that help you put just right amount of pressure on any part of your body for pain relief. Primarily for your neck and shoulders, these massagers are just as effective in relieving muscle pain on your back, thighs, legs and feet too! Foam Rollers and Massage Balls Not your typical massage balls or "foam" rollers! These are revolutionary massage devices for muscle recovery include advanced features such as intensity and vibration modes to enhance your muscle repair experience. Designed to relieve users from soreness by deeply penetrating into muscles for myofascial release, deep tissue massage and trigger point therapy. Massage Guns Introducing Zyllion's very own massage gun! Powerful, yet quiet and compact, our first model does not disappoint. Our percussive massager easily digs deep and penetrates into muscle tissue, helping break down any stiff and painful knots. As Seen On Massager Collections Shop our most popular shiatsu massagers.
